description: Captured production bug (conv id=52, phone 917575092467): customer twice explicitly confirmed PR17761 (Traditional Choli, Red, XL, ₹3,999) after completing an unrelated order for SR31045 (Georgette Party Wear). The stale last_shown_sku=SR31045 from the completed order was blindly repinned on a bare 'yes', and the order placed was SR31045 Red/M x2 = ₹2,200 — wrong SKU, wrong size, wrong price.
root_cause: last_shown_sku was only ever written by the deterministic product-card path. Products resolved via the LLM open_browsing route (e.g. 'choli che?' -> PR17761) never updated it, so it stayed stale at the previous order's SKU.
fix: app.services.conversation_service.set_last_shown_sku() is now the single writer, called from BOTH the deterministic card path and the open_browsing LLM-resolved path (backend/app/routers/webhook.py, open_browsing branch). See backend/tests/test_render_reply.py for the regression coverage.

messages.content: yes I want to buy red choli xl size
